bodies.officialName: Aggregate and Sand Producers Association of Southern Africa
bodies.notes: ASPASA describes voluntary producer, affiliate, associate and individual membership. Producer operations are distinct from suppliers. Its about page records 32 producer members and 15 associate members; the saved historical artwork instead exposes 40 producer-company rows and 26 associate rows. The differing dates and scope are preserved without inventing a current total, and multiple operations per company are not reported as company counts.

The official page describes the Council as a mining industry employers' organisation and publishes company and association members with commodity or participant labels. Association members are not operating companies and contractors are kept separate from mine operators.

IQSA's own about page states that membership is open to individuals rather than companies and that it is not a trade association. Company membership must never be inferred from an employee's IQSA membership.
International professional body with affiliated national institutes, including South Africa. It is not evidence of corporate membership.

GAIN publishes association and company membership categories. The live page checked on 2026-11-11 labels ASPASA as a Full Member for South Africa; an earlier search extract with an inconsistent region label was not used as evidence.

bodies.officialName: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
bodies.notes: Formerly DMRE. The D1-2026 operating mines directory is an official operational directory, not a membership list and not by itself proof of a current right for every listed operation. Company-specific rights require a current register or title record.

A statutory tripartite advisory council established by the Mine Health and Safety Act. Employer representation on the Council is not voluntary trade-association membership; regulation by the Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate is recorded separately.

bodies.officialName: Master Builders and Allied Trades Association Western Cape
bodies.notes: The live directory reported 346 results on 2026-11-11 and publishes member-since year, membership type, category and certificate links. The existing Maps workbook import has 345 reconciled companies and was not independently rechecked; only rows visible in the live-page review are marked Confirmed in this batch.
National federation of autonomous regional Master Builders associations. A company's regional MBA membership must not be duplicated as a separate direct MBSA company membership without evidence.

bodies.officialName: South African Forum of Civil Engineering Contractors
bodies.notes: Registered voluntary employers' organisation for civil engineering contractors. The current homepage publishes a rotating member-logo sample, not a complete accessible register; logo rows are Unverified unless a company profile or council page provides further evidence.

CESA publishes a member-firm directory. Its easily downloadable geographic and alphabetic PDFs are dated 2020/2021 and therefore Historical; the live search requires current company-by-company verification.
Official current member-bank list. It is not a banking licence register and does not include every regulated bank or foreign representative office.

bodies.officialName: Prudential Authority, South African Reserve Bank
bodies.notes: Regulator registers are recorded as regulation, never membership. The current locally controlled bank register is dated 2026. Different registers cover foreign-controlled banks, branches, mutual banks and representative offices.
CODI states that membership is automatic and compulsory for registered banks. This is a statutory participation relationship, distinct from voluntary BASA membership and from PA licensing.

FSCA authorisation or registration is a regulatory relationship, not membership. Company records must identify the specific register and licence class before a regulatory relationship is marked Confirmed.

bodies.officialName: Association for Savings and Investment South Africa
bodies.notes: Separate official lists exist for voting, non-voting ordinary, non-voting affiliate and non-voting associate members. Affiliate suppliers and offshore associate structures must not be treated as direct South African competitors.

The official page narrative reports 55 non-life insurer and reinsurer members, while 53 linked logo rows were exposed in the 2026-11-11 retrieval. Only the 53 visible rows are imported and the discrepancy remains explicit. Names not exposed as alt text are preserved from identifiable official brand links and asset names; no licence claim is inferred.
Directory categories distinguish owners, developers, managers, consultants and individual professionals. The page itself is dated 2024-04-25; undated changes after that page date cannot be assumed.
Membership is restricted to JSE-listed REITs registered in South Africa. Advisory members are a separate category and are not REIT operators.

bodies.officialName: Agricultural Business Chamber of South Africa
bodies.notes: Official member page separates Corporate, Industry Association, Basic (Sliding) and Basic participants. Agbiz Grain and Agbiz Grain associate registers are separate, more operationally precise sourcing directories.
Specialist grain handling and storage network. Equipment, laboratory and associate suppliers are published separately from grain-operator members.

bodies.officialName: Consumer Goods Council of South Africa
bodies.notes: CGCSA describes a broad member base but no complete current public membership register was found in this pass. Board employers are captured as committee representation only, not silently converted into confirmed company memberships.
CSSA has company and individual directory participants. Its Ready-mixed Concrete Work Group and committee are separate from SARMA and from regulatory product certification.

Historical company disclosures describe SARMA membership and plant audits. A current authoritative public register was not established in this pass, so current company membership remains Unknown unless separately evidenced; historical claims are dated and never presented as current.
